blurb: Guests take helicopter tours over Kauai to see inaccessible natural landmarks including the Na Pali Coast, Waimea Canyon, Mount Waialeale crater, and Jurassic Falls. Tours range from 50 to 80 minutes, with options to land at the base of Jurassic Falls. The company operates six-seat Airbus AStar helicopters with doors on and floor-to-ceiling windows for viewing.
extraNote: Free cancellation up to 48 hours before tour; inside 48 hours contact operator · Weather decisions made by pilot; flights rescheduled if visibility is poor · Lihue Airport, 3788 Ahukini Road, Lihue
